sources: Models, prices and context limits come from models.dev; Anthropic-compatible and balance endpoints come from cc-switch. DeepSeek bills twice the listed price in its weekday peak hours (01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC), and from 16:00 UTC on 31 October 2026 $0.75 per 1,000 web searches and page fetches its server runs for Claude Code and Codex; estimates follow both, from its own pricing page. Relays that resell other providers' subscriptions are not listed.
noLimit: No limit, runs on this machine
emptyConnected: Nothing is connected yet. Use Connect on a provider or Add provider.

dialog.aliasHint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. It also names the profile folders.
dialog.keyHint: Encrypted with Windows DPAPI for your Windows account and never shown again.
dialog.local: This provider runs on your machine, so no key is needed.
dialog.runnersHint: One profile per runner, each with its own config folder.

signIn.signOutConfirm: Sign {{alias}} out of {{provider}}? This deletes the profile folder {{path}}: its sign-in, sessions and settings. Your other profiles and your own CLI folder stay as they are.
signIn.waiting: Finish signing in with {{provider}} in your browser. This line updates when you are done.

signIn.private: The CLI keeps its sign-in in this profile's folder. Crewyard never sees or stores it.
signIn.update: Gemini CLI {{current}} would keep the sign-in in your own home folder, not in this profile. Update it to {{min}} or newer first:

keyCheck.latencyNote: Shown for you only; it never triggers a handoff or fallback.

catalog.title: Catalog versions
catalog.pinAbout: Pinning keeps estimates on one version. Background refreshes still download new prices but do not switch until you unpin; every spend row keeps the version its price came from.
catalog.pinnedHint: Estimates use this catalog version until you unpin it under Versions.

check.title: Price check against LiteLLM
check.about: Catalog prices that differ from LiteLLM's community price table by more than {{pct}}% in input, output or cache read. Shown only: this never changes a price.
check.never: Not checked yet. It runs with a catalog refresh, or now with Check now.
check.failed: LiteLLM's table could not be read, so differences are unknown. {{error}}
check.summary_one: Checked {{time}} against version {{hash}} · {{matched}} models matched · {{count}} price over {{pct}}%
check.summary_other: Checked {{time}} against version {{hash}} · {{matched}} models matched · {{count}} prices over {{pct}}%
check.source: Source: BerriAI/litellm model_prices_and_context_window.json (MIT). Prices in USD per 1M tokens. {{providers}} catalog providers are matched through a fixed mapping; China endpoints and coding plans are left out because they are priced differently.
